title: Package Handoff Cleanup: Agent notes stop duplicating export state

ciFast.note: Fast verification is claimed only after v0.15.184 is pushed and the GitHub Actions run passes.

deploy.note: Pages deploy is not claimed until the pushed v0.15.184 release completes its deploy run.

ciDeep.note: This is a UI handoff and release-truth cleanup; focused UI tests plus normal gates are the release bar.

liveProvider.note: No new provider package is claimed. A fresh deployed GPT-5.4-mini audit remains required after deploy.

manualHuman.note: No external instructor approval is claimed by this release.

claims.summary: Caveated downloadable Agent receipts now present as Package notes with Notes saved instead of echoing the export card's Ready with notes state.
Direct finish responses now tell instructors that package notes were saved instead of repeating download availability.
proofCommands: rg -n "Package notes saved|Download is available" src/components/chat/ChatPanel.jsx src/components/chat/__tests__/ChatPanel.agentCommands.test.jsx

claims.summary: ChatPanel tests now mirror production behavior: the custom-tools header affordance is hidden when there are no tools and no sync error.
proofCommands: rg -n "hides the custom-tools header affordance|tools\?\.length \|\| syncError" src/components/chat/__tests__

claims.summary: The export panel keeps the compact amber Ready with notes state while avoiding the longer Agent receipt copy.
proofCommands: rg -n "Notes in Agent|Download is ready\. Review notes are saved" src/components/ExportSidePanel.jsx src/components/__tests__/ExportSidePanel.readiness.test.jsx

claims.summary: The v0.15.183 no-derivatives source trust rule remains part of the current release baseline while the handoff UI is cleaned up.
Vitest now has a repo-level timeout that lets heavy compiler fixtures finish under full-suite parallel load without changing assertions.

knownRemainingTargets: A fresh deployed v0.15.184 GPT-5.4-mini ZIP/log audit must verify the cleaner handoff with real provider output.
Browser capture remains unstable: Chrome can list EduTool tabs, but the latest claimTab attempt timed out before a fresh provider run could start.
Texture below 100 remains a monitoring target even when packages round to clean 100/A.
A clean release claim still requires UI, ZIP, manifest, QUALITY_REPORT, SOURCE_REPORT, digest, and local regrade agreement.
